Submodules¶

pysnap.docview module¶

Helpers for opening bundled HTML documentation.

pysnap.docview.documentation_index_path()[source]¶

Return the bundled documentation index page path.

The installed wheel stores compiled HTML files inside pysnap/docs. During development, PySnap also accepts the Sphinx build directory under docs/_build/html as a fallback.

Returns:

Path to the index.html entry point.

Raises:

PySnapError – If no compiled HTML documentation is available.

Return type:

Path

pysnap.docview.open_bundled_documentation(browser=None)[source]¶

Launch a browser that opens the bundled HTML documentation.

Parameters:

browser (str | None) – Optional browser executable. When omitted, firefox is used.

Returns:

Path to the opened documentation index page.

Raises:

PySnapError – If the documentation or browser executable is unavailable.

Return type:

Path
